subject: Ridgeview: sudden throughput spiral + 5xxs (urgent)
messages:
From: Elena Park <epark@ridgeviewhealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai; support@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ridgeview: sudden throughput spiral + 5xxs (urgent)

Hey Dylan,

We started seeing a sharp degradation on our production fleet at ~07:50 PDT. Token latencies shot from ~120ms to >1.2s and our 5xx rate climbed from ~0.3% to 6.7% across a subset of requests. Throughput dropped as clients began retrying — it looks like a positive feedback loop.

What we see in our dashboard:
- Region: us-east-1a primarily impacted, but some hits in us-east-1b as retries overflow
- Error type: backend 503s and increased OOM NPU errors reported by the agent logs
- Impact: ~18% of requests experienced >2s tail latency in the last 20m

We've attached a small log bundle and a CSV of sampled request IDs. Can you run an initial root-cause triage and advise if you recommend an immediate cross-region redirect? Our ops team is ready to coordinate.

We need a plan in the next 30 minutes if possible — this is customer-facing traffic and we're starting to see error alerts from internal SLAs.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform Reliability, Ridgeview Health
---
Attachments: ridgeview_logs_20290427.tar.gz (log bundle), rvr_affected_requests.csv (csv sample)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <epark@ridgeviewhealth.com>
Cc: support@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ridgeview: sudden throughput spiral + 5xxs (urgent)

Thanks for the report and the logs, Elena. I'm digging in now. Initial notes:
- We've flagged elevated KV cache miss rates for hot prefixes in us-east-1a and a burst of long-running decoder steps that match the request IDs you attached.
- Infra has been asked to pull GPU memory and scheduler traces for the last 40 minutes.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether any recent rollout (model or traffic policy) occurred in the last 2 hours? Also confirm whether Ridgeview enabled any larger batch-sizes or sampler changes — those can amplify tail latency.

If the problem is workload-amplified (token spiraling), my immediate mitigation recommendation is:
1) reduce max_batch_size and disable speculative batching for your priority route in us-east-1a
2) progressively drain a fraction of traffic to us-west-2 while maintaining sticky routing for sessions that are sensitive

I'm escalating to our on-call exec and routing lead now. Please standby for a DocuSign/approval link if we need cross-region drain permission.

—Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Ridgeview: sudden throughput spiral + 5xxs (urgent)

Looping infra/routing. Quick status:
- Routing lead confirms us-east-1a host pool is operating near capacity and a subset of nodes show repeated JVM GC stalls coincident with increased batch sizes.
- Observability: KV cache hit ratio dropped from 92% to 58% on hot prefixes (per Dylan's note).
- No model rollout recorded in the last 4 hours on our side.

Proposed immediate actions (please ack):
- Throttle incoming concurrency for Ridgeview's primary key to 30% of baseline for 15m
- Activate cross-region drain for 20% of sessions to us-west-2 (sticky sessions preserved)
- Notify Ridgeview of a temporary rate-limit plan and request they suspend heavy retry logic client-side for 30 minutes

Vanessa
Head of Customer Ops (on-call)

From: Elena Park <epark@ridgeviewhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ridgeview: sudden throughput spiral + 5xxs (urgent)

Thanks — we confirm no rollout and we just disabled client-side aggressive retries. We approve the progressive drain to us-west-2 for a test cohort.

One note: a small percentage of our sessions are region-anchored for compliance reasons (latency-sensitive dashboards). Please avoid moving those; I'll send a UUID list now.

—Elena

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai; Elena Park <epark@ridgeviewhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Apr 2029 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ridgeview: sudden throughput spiral + 5xxs (urgent)

Post-mitigation update:
- We throttled concurrency and disabled speculative batching for Ridgeview's route at 09:00 PDT, and initiated a 20% sticky drain to us-west-2 (09:05 PDT).
- Within 12 minutes we observed tail latency reduce from >1.2s to ~180ms and 5xxs decreased to 0.6%. Throughput returned to ~92% of baseline as retries subsided.
- Remaining investigation: two GPU hosts in us-east-1a show intermittent NPU OOM errors under high micro-batch fanout; infra has tickets to repro and schedule hardware replacement for affected nodes.

Thanks for the fast coordination — will keep you posted on hardware remediation and whether a longer-term routing policy (preferred-region pin + spillover) should be configured.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
